the characterisation of the amber from different archaeological and geological sources.

the application of multi-analytical techniques to the characterisation of amber from archaeological and geological origins, with the aim of providing a simple and rapid method of identification of these materials, which are widely used in the archaeological record.

the combination of FTIR, micro-Raman, XRF, XPS, and SEM techniques provides a very useful methodology for the characterisation of amber samples from archaeological and geological sources.
